incidents.title: Pipeline ingest_finance_prod failed: ERP connection authentication

symptoms.description: AADSTS7000222: The provided client secret keys for app 'app-fabric-erp-reader' are expired.

incidents.resolution_summary: Client secret for app-fabric-erp-reader expired (6-month rotation). New secret issued and connection conn-erp-gl-prod credential updated; pipeline rerun at 06:20.

incidents.title: Pipeline ingest_inventory_prod failed under capacity throttling

symptoms.description: Spark session could not be started. Capacity 'Contoso PROD F64' has exceeded its limits (CapacityLimitExceeded).

incidents.resolution_summary: Capacity saturated by ml_feature_backfill (Data Science Sandbox). Pipeline rerun at 07:15 after the backfill completed.

incidents.title: Semantic model FinanceSemanticModel refresh failed

symptoms.description: Refresh failed: the gateway data source credentials are invalid.

incidents.resolution_summary: Data source credential re-entered by the dataset owner; refresh rerun.

incidents.title: Pipeline ingest_inventory_prod failed under capacity throttling

symptoms.description: Notebook execution failed: Capacity 'Contoso PROD F64' has exceeded its limits and background operations are being rejected.

incidents.resolution_summary: Second Monday in a row. Rerun after contention cleared; follow-up raised to move ml_feature_backfill off the PROD capacity (not yet actioned).

incidents.title: Pipeline ingest_sales_prod failed: upstream column rename

symptoms.description: Notebook execution failed at cell 4: AnalysisException: expected column "order_ts" is missing from input schema of sales_orders_raw.

incidents.resolution_summary: CRM release 2026.08 renamed order_ts to order_timestamp. transform_sales schema mapping updated, promoted via deployment pipeline, pipeline rerun at 07:10. sales_gold SLA missed by 40 minutes.
